{{Quote|There is an abandoned Wookiee village to the north. They all end up there when the madness settles in. I do not know what the draw of this place is.|[[Sera Jossi]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DtCW" />}}
An '''abandoned Wookiee village''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], at a short distance north of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], this village was already abandoned for a long time. However, sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Wookiees afflicted by a strange new disease gathered in the village. The illness gave rise to a madness which compelled the anguished Wookiees to attack anyone who approached them. As these Wookiees became dangerous, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] issued [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]], via bounty [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Stren Colo]], for the crazy Wookiees. Various adventurers therefore attacked the village to kill insane Wookiees and claim the Imperial bounties.<ref name="SWG:DtCW" /> Eventually, in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer working for a woman named [[Sera Jossi]] visited the village and killed the Wookiee [[Wrhisch]], one of the first to come under the sickness. Wrhisch's liver later allowed a Wookiee bio-engineer, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Cheyerooto]], to develop a cure.<ref name="SWG:SJ">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Sera Jossi|Kashyyyk}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The abandoned Wookiee village appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DtCW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The village was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:DtCW" />
